title: Subkv: Quantizing Long Context KV Cache for Sub‐Billion Parameter Language Models on Edge Devices
selection_reason: SubKV uses key/channel and value/token quantization plus dynamic-window handling to reduce KV-cache size for long-context inference on edge devices.
